archetype: quantitative grid, single validation hero panel
core_conclusion: Show the observed official validation trajectory and the checkpoint selected by the fixed overall minFDE6 rule, without inferring convergence between evaluations.

evidence_chain.original_15000: Original best checkpoint metadata, verified against the existing source manifest SHA256.
evidence_chain.stage3a_plus: The six immutable official validation observations at steps 15500 through 18000.
evidence_chain.stage3a_plusplus: Only completed official validation observations at 500-step intervals after step 18000, with a hard maximum of step 21000.
evidence_chain.selection: Strictly lowest overall full-horizon minFDE6 among the 18000 source and the newly executed observations.

panel: Overall, Vehicle, Pedestrian and Bicycle minFDE6 observations on shared axes, distinguished by both marker shape and color.

drawing.data_marks: One marker at each true validation observation; no connecting/interpolated, fitted, smoothed or resampled data lines.
drawing.reference_lines: Vertical original-best 15000, Stage3A+ best 18000 and final-best if changed; these are stage references, not inferred data.
drawing.annotation: Frozen best, actual global step and observed overall minFDE6, placed beside the plot.

statistics.split: nuScenes official VAL, 150 scenes; no test use
statistics.metric: Actor-window mean endpoint error of the best-FDE mode among K=6; full 12-timestep future only.
statistics.uncertainty: No confidence interval or significance claim; the graph shows true evaluations of one training run.
statistics.selection_rule: Full-horizon official VAL overall minFDE6, strict improvement.

review_risks: Small changes are shown in the true observed axis range; the y axis is labelled in metres.
The original 15000 point and the 18000 source are reused observations, not new inference.
The final independent inference may differ by numerical tolerance from selection-time values; the plot uses original selection-time observations.
Budget freezing and five-validation patience convergence are separate decisions.
